description: POST /approvals/{approval_id}/responses (§5.2). Users only. A Skip carries no delegation (outside this schema; the server drops one it is sent) and is never refused for step-up (API-7). An `approved` without step-up bound to the content hash, or with a delegation and no step-up bound to the preview's step_up_digest (§5.3), is the server's 401 step_up_required, not a schema refusal. API-7 leniency (DEC-682 item 27): this schema is what a client should send; the server is lenient. Lenient for `skipped` only: `verdict` and `content_hash` are strict, and an omitted, unknown, or unparsable `record`, `step_up`, or `delegation` (or any other member) is dropped. An `approved` is not risk reduction and is judged strictly. The 202 lists every dropped member's JSON pointer in `dropped`. Skip's content_hash stays strict: an answer binds what was shown (API-12).
